fixed.member: og cook: the shared cook cache
fixed.summary: A texture, sound or font cooked once on a machine is reused by every project there that cooks the same file the same way. Its entry in the shared cache (`~/.cache/origingame/cook-v1`) was keyed by all the cook's options, among them the paths of the game's own code, so no two projects with code ever shared one and each re-encoded every texture. The key is now the file's bytes, the output's type and its stamp. Entries written by older builds are not read.

A large normal, metallic-roughness or other UASTC texture encodes on the cores the rest of the cook leaves idle, with the same bytes as on one thread; before, each texture took one thread, so a cook ended waiting on its largest texture alone (a 2048x2048 normal map: 142 s on one thread of 16). Outputs with the least work cook first. The same cold cook of a model with 1024x1024 maps: 48.9 s to 19.5 s on 16 cores.

A model cooks beside the textures instead of before anything else: planning no longer cooks models to learn their LOD surfaces, which are cooked in a second round (the report's `derived` stage) once the model that charts them has. Models load on all cores, and a material's occlusion and metallic-roughness maps are packed into one texture when that texture cooks, not on every cook that loads the model.

fixed.member: og cook: the project's cook index
fixed.summary: The cook no longer copies every source file into the shared cache directory (a 932 MB project put 932 MB there); `.og/cook-index` keeps each file's hash by its stat. A new texture's or sound's fingerprint for the asset index is taken on all cores.

fixed.member: og cook: stale models and Rive images
fixed.summary: A model cooked while the game's code never raycast is cooked again, with its raycast structure, once the code begins to (`mesh.raycast` was in no cook stamp, so the model stayed as cooked). A Rive file's embedded images are cooked again when the texture settings change (`cook { color_textures }`), which their stamps did not hold.
